description: This source file contains unit tests for the GoldenPathLeaseProvider class, verifying its lease acquisition, renewal, release, and lifecycle behaviors.

classes.name: GoldenPathLeaseProviderTestRunner
classes.description: A test runner class that provides methods to test lease operations such as acquire, release, and renew on a lease provider.

methods.name: ProviderCanAcquireLeases
methods.description: Tests whether the lease provider can successfully acquire multiple leases.

methods.name: ProviderCanReleaseLeases
methods.description: Tests whether the lease provider can successfully release acquired leases.

methods.name: ProviderCanRenewLeases
methods.description: Tests whether the lease provider can successfully renew leases.

methods.name: Provider_TryAcquireLeaseWhichBelongToOtherEntity_Return_LeaseNotAvailable
methods.description: Validates that acquiring a lease on an already leased resource returns LeaseNotAvailable.

methods.name: Provider_TryRenewLeaseWithWrongToken_Return_InvalidToken
methods.description: Checks that renewing a lease with an invalid token results in an InvalidToken response.

methods.name: Provider_LifeCycle_Acqurie_Renew_Release_ShouldBeAbleToAcquireLeaseOnTheSameResourceAfterRelease
methods.description: Verifies the full lifecycle: acquire, renew, release, then re-acquire on the same resource, ensuring tokens differ after release.
